description: Plain T-SQL stored procedures on SQL Server as Dagster assets -- the T-SQL equivalent of ssis_workspace for shops that run ETL directly out of stored procedures, not SSIS. Discovers sys.procedures + optionally executes via EXEC, subsettable (selecting one procedure runs only that procedure). Workspace shape: connection block + procedure_selector for filtering + assets_by_procedure for per-procedure overrides/deps/params + polling_sensor observing SQL-Agent-triggered runs via msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory. demo_mode runs the whole shape with a synthetic catalog and zero SQL Server dependency.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per discovered stored procedure. With action=noop (default) each asset is declare-only (external asset). With action=execute each materialization calls EXEC [schema].[procedure] with assets_by_procedure.params bound as parameters. No inputs. Optional polling_sensor emits AssetObservation per completed SQL-Agent-triggered job run.

connection.label: Connection
connection.description: Connection to the SQL Server instance hosting the stored procedures (SQLAlchemy URL or flat fields).

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Skip the real SQL Server connection entirely. Discovery returns a synthetic 2-procedure catalog; execute and the polling sensor log a simulated lifecycle instead of running real T-SQL.

procedure_selector.label: Procedure Selector
procedure_selector.description: Filter which stored procedures become Dagster assets. Omit for every procedure in every schema.

assets_by_procedure.label: Assets By Procedure
assets_by_procedure.description: Override the asset spec for specific procedures, keyed by qualified name '<schema>.<procedure>'. Mirrors the official dagster-databricks DatabricksWorkspaceComponent.assets_by_task_key shape. Use deps: to declare real run-order between procedures; params: for EXEC parameter values ({partition_key}/{run_id} substituted); sql_agent_job_name: for polling_sensor coverage.

action.label: Action
action.description: noop = external asset (declare-only); execute = EXEC [schema].[procedure] with assets_by_procedure.params bound as parameters. execute is subsettable (can_subset=true) -- selecting one procedure only runs that procedure (plus any assets_by_procedure dependency ahead of it), not every discovered procedure.

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: If true, adds ONE sensor (not one per procedure) that polls msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory for completions of each procedure's sql_agent_job_name and emits AssetObservation for runs Dagster did not itself trigger. Procedures with no sql_agent_job_name set are skipped.

observation_interval_seconds.label: Observation Interval (seconds)
observation_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between sensor polls. Only used when polling_sensor=True.

partition_type.label: Partition Type
partition_type.description: 'daily'|'weekly'|'monthly'|'hourly'|'cron'|'static'|'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned. Applies the SAME partitions_def to every imported procedure.

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: ISO start date for time-based partition types (e.g. '2024-01-01').

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

name: SQL Server Stored Procedure Workspace
